narratives.question: Tell me about this data.
narratives.narrative: A few instruction texts dominate the dataset while most are seen only once. Enterprise orders average $545.08 per order, SMBs at $182.27 and consumers at $59.77. narratives.question: What are the most common recipe types?
narratives.narrative:
The most common recipe types are the generic 'E' category, followed by 'Pfannkuchen', 'Se', 'Gef', and 'K'.
- Top five: E (602), Pfannkuchen (552), Se (520), Gef (497) and K (480)
- Next tier: Tomaten (455) and Llte (438)
- Lower tier: Auflauf (402), B (398), and H (388)

Overall picture: a long tail of types, with 'E' dominating. A few recipes make up the bulk of rows. Here a handful of recipe titles dominate the listing. Overall, most recipes have their own unique steps.

narratives.question: What stands out?
narratives.narrative: Enterprise customers average $545.08 per order, well above the other segments. Readmitted patients (4) have a higher average glucose and a longer average stay (10.5 months). No other variable differentiates the outcomes. Both groups share the same mode year (2022) and identical glucose-outcome correlation. The month-to-outcome correlation is also identical (–0.501). No other country appears in the data. Higher unit prices are associated with lower quantities. A small handful of products account for a disproportionate share of sales. Hand warmers are among the most frequent products. No other work type is listed, so this is the only rate available.
